faqs.q: What is Close Headroom Trolley Chain Hoist used for?
faqs.a: Close Headroom Trolley Chain Hoist is a manual chain hoist built into a trolley that runs along the beam flange, with a close-headroom design for places where there is little space under the beam. It is listed in 5 sizes, 0.5 t to 5 t.

faqs.q: How do I read an Indus part number for Close Headroom Trolley Chain Hoist, such as IH-LR-CB-CHT-0T5?
faqs.a: Close Headroom Trolley Chain Hoist part numbers begin with IH-LR-CB-CHT and end in a size code: IH-LR-CB-CHT-0T5 is the 0.5 t size and IH-LR-CB-CHT-5T is the 5 t size. Quote the full part number from the size table, or give us the size and the load you need, when you enquire.

faqs.q: What sizes does Close Headroom Trolley Chain Hoist come in?
faqs.a: Close Headroom Trolley Chain Hoist is listed in 5 sizes, 0.5 t to 5 t, each with its own Indus part number, for example IH-LR-CB-CHT-0T5 and IH-LR-CB-CHT-5T. The table includes 0.5 t: WLL 0.5 t, proof load 7.5 kN and 5 t: WLL 5 t, proof load 75 kN.

faqs.q: How do I choose the right size of Close Headroom Trolley Chain Hoist?
faqs.a: For Close Headroom Trolley Chain Hoist, choose on capacity, on the beam flange width the trolley adjusts to, and on the headroom you have; the size table lists the beam flange range and the minimum curve radius for each size.

faqs.q: What is the rated load of Close Headroom Trolley Chain Hoist?
faqs.a: Close Headroom Trolley Chain Hoist is listed with a working load limit 0.5 to 5 t. For example, 2 t: WLL 2 t, proof load 30 kN. The working load is the figure to lift or load to; proof and breaking loads are test figures and never working limits.

faqs.q: What material and finish is Close Headroom Trolley Chain Hoist supplied in?
faqs.a: The listing for Close Headroom Trolley Chain Hoist does not state the material or the finish. Tell us the environment it will work in and any material standard or coating you need, and we confirm what the maker can supply before you order.

faqs.q: What standard and certificate apply to Close Headroom Trolley Chain Hoist?
faqs.a: For Close Headroom Trolley Chain Hoist, the listing gives its documentation as: Manufacturer's test certificate. For third-party certification or a witnessed proof test, say so on the RFQ before the order is placed.

faqs.q: What does Close Headroom Trolley Chain Hoist connect to or work with?
faqs.a: For Close Headroom Trolley Chain Hoist, the trolley runs on the flange of an I-beam, and the beam and its supports must carry the hoist and the load. See the [beam trolleys shelf](/c/beam-trolleys) for separate push and geared trolleys.

faqs.q: How should Close Headroom Trolley Chain Hoist be inspected and looked after?
faqs.a: Check the beam flange fit, trolley wheels and stops, the load chain and hooks before use. Keep the chain free of twists and have Close Headroom Trolley Chain Hoist inspected periodically by a competent person.

faqs.q: How does Close Headroom Trolley Chain Hoist differ from Wire Rope Puller — Aluminium?
faqs.a: Close Headroom Trolley Chain Hoist differs from [Wire Rope Puller — Aluminium](/p/wire-rope-puller-aluminium) in its size range 0.5 t to 5 t against 8.3mm; working load limit 0.5 to 5 t against 800 kg.

faqs.q: How are Close Headroom Trolley Chain Hoist shipped, and can they be exported from Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes. We ship Close Headroom Trolley Chain Hoist from our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, to buyers in the GCC, Africa, Asia and beyond, with export documents prepared for the destination. Give us the part numbers, quantities and delivery country through our contact page and we quote the freight and lead time with the price.

faqs.q: Is the Close Headroom Trolley Chain Hoist available from Indus Hydraulics in Dubai, and what is the lead time?
faqs.a: The Close Headroom Trolley Chain Hoist is built to order and supplied from Dubai, UAE, with shipping worldwide. The lead time is confirmed on the quotation. Send the size, rating and quantity through [our contact page](/contact) and we confirm the build and delivery date.

faqs.q: What is Lever Hoist, Type D used for?
faqs.a: Lever Hoist, Type D is a lever hoist, a hand-operated ratchet-lever block with a geared load sheave and an automatic load brake, used for lifting, pulling and tensioning loads in any direction. It is listed in 5 sizes, 0.8 t to 9 t.

faqs.a: Lever Hoist, Type D part numbers begin with IH-LR-CB-LVD and end in a size code: IH-LR-CB-LVD-0P8T is the 0.8 t size and IH-LR-CB-LVD-9T is the 9 t size. Quote the full part number from the size table, or give us the size and the load you need, when you enquire.

faqs.q: What sizes does Lever Hoist, Type D come in?
faqs.a: Lever Hoist, Type D is listed in 5 sizes, 0.8 t to 9 t, each with its own Indus part number, for example IH-LR-CB-LVD-0P8T and IH-LR-CB-LVD-9T. The table includes 0.8 t: WLL 0.8 t, proof load 0.96 t and 9 t: WLL 9 t, proof load 10.8 t.

faqs.q: How do I choose the right size of Lever Hoist, Type D?
faqs.a: For Lever Hoist, Type D, choose by capacity and by the standard lift, and say on the RFQ if you need a longer load chain. A lever hoist pulls in any direction, so it also serves for tensioning and positioning; it is never used with an extension on the lever.

faqs.q: What is the rated load of Lever Hoist, Type D?
faqs.a: Lever Hoist, Type D is listed with a working load limit 0.8 to 9 t. For example, 3.2 t: WLL 3.2 t, proof load 3.84 t. The working load is the figure to lift or load to; proof and breaking loads are test figures and never working limits.

faqs.q: What is Lever Hoist, Type D made from, and what finish does it have?
faqs.a: For Lever Hoist, Type D, the material is Steel body, alloy load chain and forged hooks; the finish is Painted. If your site needs a particular material grade, coating or material certificate, say so on the enquiry and we confirm it before the order.

faqs.q: What standard and certificate apply to Lever Hoist, Type D?
faqs.a: Lever Hoist, Type D is listed to Manual lever hoist. The listing gives its documentation as: Manufacturer's test certificate. For third-party certification or a witnessed proof test, say so on the RFQ before the order is placed.

faqs.q: What does Lever Hoist, Type D connect to or work with?
faqs.a: For Lever Hoist, Type D, attach it with rated shackles, slings or beam clamps of at least the same working load. For lifting from a beam, see the [beam trolleys shelf](/c/beam-trolleys), and for hand-chain alternatives the [chain blocks shelf](/c/chain-blocks-manual-hoists).

faqs.q: How should Lever Hoist, Type D be inspected and looked after?
faqs.a: Before use, check the load chain for stretch and nicks, the hooks and their latches, and that the ratchet and load brake hold. Never lengthen the lever with a bar, and have Lever Hoist, Type D inspected periodically by a competent person.
